messages:
deploybot: Attempted unpin for runtime v3.3.0 on model group 'gptx-lite' failed auto-checks. Unpin blocked: 22% hosts missing SDK 4.0. See /deploy/logs/1811110001 for details.

sophia: TL;DR — did any hosts actually unpin or was it fully aborted?

andre: Canary removed pin only on eu-canary. Global unpin aborted because `host-compat` reported ~22% incompatible hosts. Quick check: `curl -sS https://infra/api/compat?model=gptx-lite&runtime=3.3.0` -> returns list of hosts with sdk_version < 4.0.

sre-oncall: Recommendation: re-pin to v3.2.9 globally to avoid split-brain while SDK rollout finishes. Define clear thresholds for unpin: host-compat >=98% and stable 30m canary.

docops: If we pin, please add release-note bullet: "Temporarily holding gptx-lite on runtime v3.2.9 while SDK 4.0 is rolled out to all host pools; customers running self-hosted SDK should upgrade to 4.0 to use runtime v3.3.0."

sophia: Proposed plan: 1) abort global unpin, 2) apply temp global pin v3.2.9 (TTL 12h), 3) execute SDK 4.0 rollout in waves, 4) monitor host-compat and latency, 5) unpin after host-compat >=98% and 30m stable canary. Owners?

andre: I'll own the SDK rollout. Starting at 01:00 UTC deploy in 10% waves. Helper check: `rbctl host-check --tag sdk=4.0 | grep missing` to track remaining hosts. I'll post wave updates here.

deploy-team: Playbook RB-33 added for pin/unpin race conditions. If mismatch persists beyond 4h, escalate to incident. Pin TTL set to 12h and manual approval required to lift pin.

sre-oncall: Alerts configured: host-compat <98% -> page SRE-oncall; p95 latency delta +200ms -> page. If pinned capacity drops <90% due to pin, run capacity mitigation runbook.

sophia: Sounds good. Locking plan; keep thread open for rollout signals and postmortem notes.

deploybot: Action recorded: Temporary pin applied: runtime v3.2.9 for gptx-lite. TTL 12h. SDK rollout job scheduled 01:00 UTC.
